objective: Improve legitimate competition PQ before further report work
tuning_partition: Original calibration only, exploratory subsequent development

models.question: Does a larger receptive field with more retained detail improve PQ? This changes depth, scale and crop geometry together and is a configuration screen, not an isolated ablation.
Does retaining baseline physical crop context and transferring its approved training weights improve native detail?

cheap_ensemble_screen.method: Resize probabilities to native resolution before convex averaging; same 25-setting reconstruction grid

inference_screen: Full-image initially; four-flip TTA for candidates within 0.005 of the non-TTA reference; tile inference if full/crop normalization is a measured concern. Record every evaluated variant.
advance: At most two improved configurations to the prospectively frozen nested grouped comparison; +0.005 exploratory PQ and credible morphology before spending on that comparison. No new submission using the original holdout result.
public_score_usage: External check for a gated improved artifact, never threshold or row-level probing.
